scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @almanac/server" "npm run dev -w @almanac/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @almanac/web && npm run build -w @almanac/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client/test && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/e2e && tsc --noEmit -p .claude/skills/question-bank
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run test:browser -w @almanac/web && npm run plans -w @almanac/server
